title: Judge’s seniority can't be affected by complaints that did not lead to disciplinary action: Chhattisgarh HC
description: The Chhattisgarh High Court recently held that judicial officers cannot be denied seniority merely because their promotion was deferred on the basis of a complaint that never culminated in disciplinary action [Chhaya Singh v. High Court of Chhattisgarh & Ors.].
